Name: (FS) Seaweed Hair
Author: fhfxafd
Description:
[u][size=5]Info
[/size][/u]
Currently has two variations of one hairstyle with strands of green seaweed in it. I plan to add more as time allows!

Hairstyle "Short Seaweed Hair" uses vanilla hair 39 as a general base and has two versions. With the One Color version, the seaweed uses the base hair color as an overlay, and shows up better with lighter/more saturated colors. With the Two Color version, the base hair color and seaweed overlay colors can be changed separately.

[size=1](...you could also use it as vines instead lol)[/size]


[u][size=5]Installation[/size][/u]

[list]
[*]Have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969?tab=description]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿ already installed.﻿
[*]Download and unzip file into your Mods folder.
[*]Enjoy!
[/list]
